query:
SELECT i.id, i.productName, i.costPrice, i.quantity, (i.costPrice * i.quantity) as deadStockValue
FROM inventory i
WHERE i.branchId = 20 
  AND i.createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND i.createdAt < '2026-06-01'
  AND i.productName NOT IN (
    SELECT DISTINCT productName FROM sales_transactions 
    WHERE branchId = 20 AND createdAt >= '2026-05-01' AND createdAt < '2026-06-01'
  );
